title: EmailSubmission/query ignores sort
description: Found in JMAP-skk9.13. crate-jmap-mail-server/src/submission.rs handle_submission_query and handle_submission_query_changes never read the sort argument, so EmailSubmission/query silently ignores sort (including malformed comparators such as sort:[5]) even though jmap-mail-types QueryObject for EmailSubmission has Comparator = EmailSubmissionComparator since a3134bb3. RFC 8620 §5.5 says a malformed argument is invalidArguments, and a sort the server cannot honour is unsupportedSort. RFC 8621 §7.3 lists emailId, threadId and sentAt as sort properties. Decode sort as EmailSubmissionComparator and pass it to the backend, as Mailbox/query does (mailbox_sort_arg).
close_reason: batch 14c: committed, adversarially verified, CI green at 7fc008f0
